Melee, the small diamonds that ring a centre stone, price by the carat and by size band — from $370 to $900, our field guide finds. A parcel is sorted by sieve size in millimetres, then compared to a master stone for four blended grades, not certified stone by stone. The bottom band, at $450 a carat, actually costs more than the next size up. Full guide on caratcapital.org, link in bio.
